optionsIntro.message: Choose how far each bookmark name reaches: only its address, the pages under it, pages whose address contains a text, or the whole site.

optionsCount.message: $ON$ of $TOTAL$ bookmarks keep their name beyond their own address

optionsNoMatchBody.message: Try another name, address or folder.

optionsNoBookmarksBody.message: Bookmark a page (Ctrl+D, or ⌘D on a Mac) and it shows up here.

optionsHow1.message: A bookmarked page shows the bookmark name as its tab title.

optionsHow2.message: “Pages under it” and “whole site” follow the tab: once the tab has been on the bookmarked address, the name stays while it browses under that address or anywhere on the site. A page with a bookmark of its own shows that name, and the tab then returns to the last “whole site” bookmark it came through. Leaving the site ends it.

optionsHow3.message: “Address contains” works in every tab, even for links opened from mail: any page of the bookmark's site whose address contains the text gets the name. Useful with several Google accounts — e.g. /u/1/ or authuser=1, a Play Console developer id or a Cloud project=… Separate alternatives with a space.

optionsHow4.message: The choice is the same here, in the extension's popup and when you right-click a page.
